name: Tierna Aeride Throne
original_name: ティエルナ＝アエルライド＝スローネ
source:
A princess who fled from Arkthrone Kingdom of Edda World to take refuge in human world. She is a neat and clean lovely girl whose appearance seems ephemeral like the brightest smile before fading away. Although she is a strong willed person, she is humble and can be an air-head sometimes. Her alias when she is at school is Nanakura Tina who was said to be a transfer student from abroad. She lives with Setsu and is a member of gymnastic club.

「The soul that has been distorted by sorcery, I shall cleanse it and purify you!」
